title: Forgot PIN says a code is on its way on WhatsApp even when WhatsApp refused to send it
what: In the older Forgot PIN way, where MettleUp sends a 6-digit code, the screen answers 'a code is on its way' at once and the message is sent afterwards. If WhatsApp refuses it (number not on WhatsApp, a payment block on MettleUp's WhatsApp account, a paused message template), the code is thrown away and the person is never told. They wait for a message that will never come, ask again, and get the same answer. This way is used only while Verify with WhatsApp is switched off.
expected: When the send fails for a number that has an account, the person is told to use the other ways back in, without giving away which numbers have accounts (for example, by always showing the other ways after a short wait).
who: owners and staff who forgot their PIN
how_often: every failed WhatsApp send while the send-a-code way is on
fix_line: After asking for a code, show the other ways back in if no code came within a minute

items.reason: Only messages here: (1) WhatsApp 6-digit code from MettleUp for Forgot PIN and new gym, fires on tap, to the typed number, switch = Worker phone-code mode, one live code per number (older ones killed), dies after 10 minutes; (2) Verify with WhatsApp, the person sends MettleUp a message, panel polls every 2.5 s only while the page is visible and stops when verified or expired; (3) Send on WhatsApp of a staff sign-in code opens the owner's own WhatsApp, nothing automatic; (4) signed-out reason shown on next open, no push. No bell, sound, pop-up, push or reminder in this area, so phone-maker sound, screen off, quiet hours and watch bridging do not apply. Support opening the records sends the owner nothing (existing finding).

WhatsApp code reaches a person only if: the Worker switch is on (mode send), the WhatsApp token and template are in place and MettleUp's WhatsApp account is not blocked, the number has a panel account (Forgot PIN), the number is on WhatsApp, under the per-number limits (wait 60 s, hourly cap) and the paid monthly cap. Verify with WhatsApp needs mode inbound, WhatsApp on the person's phone, them pressing Send, and Meta passing the message to MettleUp.
Staff & sign-in shows per person whether a PIN is set, but not whether their mobile was ever proven or is on WhatsApp, so the owner cannot see who could get a Forgot PIN code.

Nothing in this area reaches members. Crispy Curves member phones 2 of 2 filled (machine file). Panel people always have a mobile because adding a person needs one; the live Worker mode is a server setting not readable from code.

Cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: the WhatsApp code message with its copy-code button arrives and shows a banner on an Android phone and an iPhone; the green Verify with WhatsApp button opens the WhatsApp app with the message typed in (and WhatsApp Web or the QR on a computer). No watch path here.
